title: KeywordList - Metadata API
description: Represents a list of keywords used in Experience Cloud site moderation. This keyword list is a type of moderation criteria that defines offensive language or inappropriate content that you don’t want in your site.

Description.description: A description of the keyword list.

keywords.description: The keywords you want moderate in your Experience Cloud site.

keyword.description: Keywords you want to moderate. Keywords can only be up to 100 characters and can include letters, numbers, spaces, and special characters. Wildcard characters aren’t supported.

declarative_metadata_sample_definition.description: The following is an example of a KeywordList component.
declarative_metadata_sample_definition.code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<KeywordList xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
   <masterLabel>Bad Word List</masterLabel>
   <description>List of bad words updated by Joe in Nov 2015.</description>
   <keywords>
     <keyword>bad-word</keyword>
   </keywords>
   <keywords>
     <keyword>b a d w o r d</keyword>
   </keywords>
   <keywords>
     <keyword>b@dword</keyword>
   </keywords>
</KeywordList>
